newsitem.title: USA: Swift Transportation CEO in transaction.
newsitem.headline: Swift Transportation CEO in transaction.

text.p: Swift Transportation Co Inc Chief Executive Jerry Moyes and his brother, Ronald Moyes, will provide $15 million to be used to buy the assets and business of the former Central Freight Lines from a unit of Caliber System Inc, Jerry Moyes said on Tuesday.
Central Freight on May 13 agreed to buy the business from Caliber's Viking Freight unit in a deal valued at $43 million, plus about $8 million in assumed debt, Jerry Moyes said in a statement.

The brothers will become majority shareholders in a new company that will operate as Central Freight Lines. Both will serve on its board of directors but will not take an active role in the management of the new company, Jerry Moyes said.
